PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Suldahalli village of Kudligi
Taluk Vijayanagara District and to constitute a new revenue villages called
Agrahara and Gunasagara as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or

Suladahalli village of Kudligi Taluk Vijayanagara District to form a new revenue
village called Agrahara of Kudligi Taluk and Vijayanagara District along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand

under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of DEVAGONDANAHALLI
village of HUVINAHADAGALI Taluk VIJAYANAGARA District and to
constitute a new revenue villages called HANAKANAHALLI ,
THIPPAPURA, GUJANOOR as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new assigned to them.
Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner,
VIJAYANAGARA District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
DEVAGONDANAHALLI village of HUVINAHADAGALI Taluk
VIJAYANAGARA District to form a new revenue village called
HANAKANAHALLI of HUVINAHADAGALI Taluk and VIJAYANAGARA
District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka propose
s to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Madaluru village of Sira Taluk of
Tumkur District and to constitute a new revenue villages called Kentaralahatti
and Upparapalya as specified in schedule.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of of
Madaluru village for conversion of Kentaralahatti and Upparapalya unrecorded
habitation in to hamlet part of the said revenue village.

Now , there fore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the
said Act, notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely
to be affected thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or
after thirty days from the date of publication of the notification in the official
Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the
date Specified above will be considered by the state Government.

Objection or suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner, Tumkur District.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Magodu village of Sira
Taluk of Tumkur District and to constitute a new revenue villages called
Doddanahalli and Kereyagalahalli as specified in schedule along with maps
with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Tumkur
District.

included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Belaguli villages of
Chikkanayakanahalli Taluk Tumkur District and to constitute a new revenue
villages called Rangapura, Gubehalli, Hosahatti and new revenue village called
Papanakona from Bangaragere and Belaguli as specified in schedule along
with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Tumkur
District.

District along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand under
land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having regard
to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka proposes to
issue a Notification to alter the limits of Hayakallu Village of Chitradurga taluk
Chitradurga District and to constitute new revenue villages called Hayakallu
Gollarahatti, Halechuri Papayyanahatti, Pelurahatti, Kotehatti and Sub Villages
Hosachuri papayyanahatti from Halechuri Papayyanahatti, Chinnuri
Thippaihnahatti from Kotehatti as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or

suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Chitradurga
District.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Hirehalli Village of
Challakere Taluk Chitradurga District and to constitute a new revenue villages
called Palanayakanakote and Rudrammanahalli as specified in schedule along
with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Chitradurga
District.
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Hirehalli Village of Challakere Taluk Chitradurga District to form a new revenue
village called Palanayakanakote of Challakere Taluk Chitradurga District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land

Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Chikkaluru Village of
Kollegala Taluk, Chamarajnagar District and to constitute a new revenue villages
called Prakashpalya, Kottanuru And Mariyapura as specified in schedule along
with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Chamarajnagar
District.

SCHEDULE – 1

Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Chikkaluru Village of Kollegala Taluk, Chamarajnagar District to form a new revenue
village called Prakashpalya Village of Kollegala Taluk, Chamarajnagar District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act 1964 ( Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration
the factors Specified in clauses ( i ) to ( iv ) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Rules 1966 such as the population, area of the village the demand
under land revenue in the village and other head of the account and having
regard to the administrative convenience the Government of Karnataka
proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Kudli village of Shimoga
taluk, Shimoga district and to constitute a new revenue villages called
Bhadrapura as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers
and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days
from the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state
Government from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date
Specified above will be considered by the state Government. Objection or
suggestion may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Shimoga
District.

SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
Kudli village of Shimoga taluk, Shimoga district to form a new revenue village called
Bhadrapura village of Shimoga taluk, Shimoga district along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 387 PFH 2022 Dated: 20-12-2022
regarding altering the limits of Hadagali village of VijaypurTaluk and Vijaypur
District and constituting a new revenue village called Mahatmagandhinagar,
Mahatmagandhinagar Upagram and Keshavapur was published as required by
section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in
the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 387 PFH 2022 dated 21-12-2022inviting objections or
suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from
the date of its publication in the Official Gazette addressed to the Deputy
Commissioner Vijaypur district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:24-08-2023, And whereas, no objections and suggestions have been received;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

village called as Mahatmagandhinagar of Vijaypur taluk Vijaypur District along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

Whereas the draft of the Notification No: RD 17 PFH 2022 Dated : 19-03-2022
regarding altering the limits of MANUR village of BASAVANA BAGEWADI Taluk,
VIJAYAPUR District and constituting a new revenue village called HANUMANA
NAGAR was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act,
1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 17 PFH 2022
Dated : 12-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette addressed to the Deputy Commissioner VIJAYAPUR district.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 28-03-2022.And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE – 1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of the said
village village of BASAVANA BAGEWADI Taluk in VIJAYAPUR District to from a
new revenue village called as HANUMANA NAGAR of BASAVANA BAGEWADI
Taluk and VIJAYAPUR District along with the survey numbers included in column
(4) there of.
